scripts.feedback: wrangler d1 execute hyperdrive-arcade --remote --command "SELECT datetime(created_at/1000,'unixepoch') AS at, initials, message, context FROM feedback ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 30"
scripts.feedback:local: wrangler d1 execute hyperdrive-arcade --local --command "SELECT datetime(created_at/1000,'unixepoch') AS at, initials, message, context FROM feedback ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 30"
